pr_title: initialize logging after flag parsing + refactor commands
pr_body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

It wasn't documented that InitLogs already uses the log flush frequency, so
some commands have called it before parsing (for example, kubectl in the
original code for logs.go). The `--log-flush-frequency` flag never had an effect
in such commands.

Other fixes:

- Print usage text before error to keep the error visible in the console when the
  usage text is long, but only print the usage text if the error actually was for
  flag parsing.
- More commands use hyphens instead of underscores in their command line.
  Parameters with underscores are still accepted.
- The validation error for `kube-apiserver --logging-format=json
   --add-dir-header` now references `add-dir-header` instead of `add_dir_header`.
- `--log-flush-frequency` is not listed anymore in the `--logging-format` flag's
   `non-default formats don't honor these flags` usage text because it will also
   work for non-default formats once it is needed. 
- `cmd/kubelet`: the description of `--logging-format` uses hyphens instead of
   underscores for the flags, which now matches what the command is using.
- `staging/src/k8s.io/component-base/logs/example/cmd`: added logging flags.
- `apiextensions-apiserver`, ` kube-aggregator`, `sample-apiserver`: they no longer
   print useless stack traces for `main` and goroutines when command line parsing fails;
   however, they also don't do that for other errors

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

There's no bug open for this as far as I know. I found the problem while refactoring the code.

It fixes some things discovered while working the code:

Fixes: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/105244

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

This turned into a major refactoring. Future changes for deprecating klog flags should become simpler.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?
```release-note
`--log-flush-frequency` had no effect in several commands or was missing. Help and warning texts were not always using the right format for a command (`add_dir_header` instead of `add-dir-header`). Fixing this included cleaning up flag handling in component-base/logs: that package no longer adds flags to the global flag sets. Commands which want the klog and --log-flush-frequency flags must explicitly call logs.AddFlags; the new cli.Run does that for commands. That helper function also covers flag normalization and printing of usage and errors in a consistent way (print usage text first if parsing failed, then the error).
```

> But why does it need to be more than:
> ```

>	command := app.NewAPIServerCommand()
>	code := component.Run(command)

With this variant there is no guaranteed flushing when the command terminates. It's not possible to hide the `defer logs.FlushLogs()` somewhere deeper in a helper method, because then returning from the helper method will flush once, but not the program exit.

One can argue that it's sufficient to put that defer into the cobra command, i.e. the same file where this PR now has most of the `InitLogs` calls or some wrapper (your ` component.Run` proposal). That is nicer because less code depends on `component-base/logs`. But then log calls during cleaning up may get lost in the in-memory buffer. Keeping `defer logs.FlushLogs()` in `main` is safer.

> This PR pushes InitLogs() into the command's RunE() but I think it should
be the framework - otherwise approximately every command's RunE() carries the
same boilerplate.

So the proposal is to wrap a Cobra command which was set up without logging so that it has the desired global log flags and then inject the log setup code between command line parsing and the original command methods. This may work for simple commands. I'll check that. If it works, then moving the `defer logs.FlushLogs` there should be sufficient.

It's going to be much harder for commands like kubelet that have [very specific logic](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/752c4b7f0b3630fb58f8489cb30748be79cde4f2/cmd/kubelet/app/server.go#L155-L263) to ensure a certain semantic of their config and flags.

The end goal is:
- that all commands support `--logging-format` - right now it only gets added to those commands which use `component-base/logs.Options`
- that `--log-flush-frequency`, `-v` and `-vmodule` also can be set via config file options

This PR is a step in that direction, but it already creates churn, and we may have to do that again when going further.

Perhaps we should just bite the bullet and immediately introduce the final API?

Here's how this could look like:
- remove `logs.AddFlags` and instead ensure that all commands have a `logs.Options` instance
- add `--log-flush-frequency` and the klog flags in `Options.AddFlags`
- remove `logs.InitLogs` and instead do the same thing in `Options.Apply`
